label: the animations are on (no ?cine=0)
E at the airlock starts its animation, not the space walk
you are at the middle of the airlock and the inner door is coming down

eval: JSON.stringify({ alarm: __game.interior.alarms.airlock, visor: __game.visorOn, see: __game.debug.see(), red: __game.lightPool.lights.some((l) => l.intensity > 0 && l.color.r > 0.9 && l.color.g < 0.3) })
label: venting: the lamps are red, you are in the suit, and the shut outer door is close in front of you (the control for the next check)
expect: r => r.alarm === 'red' && r.visor === true && r.red && typeof r.see.dist === 'number' && r.see.dist < 3

label: the outer door and the hull's door are open, and the view goes out through them (nothing within 50 m)
it ends in the space walk with full air, the airlock reset, the visor's rim round the view
expect: r => r.s.phase === 'eva' && r.s.eva.o2 >= 178 && r.outer === 0 && r.inner === 1 && r.visor

label: beside the airlock in the suit
E: the way in is an animation too
inside, the outer door shut behind you, the air coming back

eval: JSON.stringify({ s: __game.stats(), inner: __game.interior.doors.airlockInner.k, alarm: __game.interior.alarms.airlock ?? null, visor: __game.visorOn })
label: back on your feet in the airlock, the inner door open, the helmet off
expect: r => r.s.phase === 'walk' && r.s.walker[0] < -5 && r.inner === 1 && r.alarm === null && r.visor === false

label: E at the Wren starts the launch
the canopy is up, the ladder out, you on it
in, canopy shut, the bay's alarm red, the wings folding

eval: (() => { const L = __game.player.obj.userData.bayDoors; return JSON.stringify({ blast: __game.interior.doors.bayUpper.k, hull: L.map((l) => Math.round((l.position.y - l.userData.home) * 10) / 10), lit: __game.bayLampsLit !== undefined }); })()
label: the blast door and the stern's door are open
through her canopy, out past the stern (the shell drawn again), the wings spreading

eval: (() => { const w = __game.parkedWren, me = __game.cinePerson; const a = w.getWorldPosition(new V3()), b = me.getWorldPosition(new V3()); return JSON.stringify({ parent: me.parent === w, d: +a.distanceTo(b).toFixed(2) }); })()
label: you ride out in her seat (s6 first drive: an event and a track crossing in one frame left you floating 27 m behind her)

eval: (() => { const k = __game.player.obj; k.updateMatrixWorld(); const l = k.worldToLocal(__game.fighterEnt.obj.position.clone()); return JSON.stringify({ s: __game.stats(), z: l.z, blast: __game.interior.doors.bayUpper.k, ladder: __game.interior.bayLadder.visible, alarm: __game.interior.alarms.bay ?? null, parked: __game.parkedWren.visible }); })()
label: it ends flying the Wren from where the animation left her, astern; the bay shut and quiet behind her
expect: r => r.s.phase === 'fighter' && r.s.fighterOut && r.z > 60 && r.blast === 0 && !r.ladder && r.alarm === null && r.parked === false

eval: (() => { const k = __game.player.obj; k.updateMatrixWorld(); const f = __game.fighterEnt.obj; f.position.copy(k.localToWorld(new V3(0, 10, 400))); f.lookAt(__game.bayMouth()); f.rotateY(Math.PI); __game.fighterFlight.throttle = 0; __game.fighterEnt.vel?.copy(__game.player.vel); return JSON.stringify({ can: __game.canRequestBay(), canLand: __game.canLand() }); })()
label: 400 m astern: the bay can be called for (and the old land-anywhere-near is not offered)
the prompt says so
E calls
the doors are open, the bay drawn through them, the prompt says to fly to them

eval: (() => { const k = __game.player.obj; const f = __game.fighterEnt.obj; f.position.copy(k.localToWorld(new V3(6, 4, 120))); return __game.inBayReach(); })()
label: 120 m out is not yet the door

eval: (() => { const k = __game.player.obj; const f = __game.fighterEnt.obj; f.position.copy(k.localToWorld(new V3(6, 4, 90))); return __game.inBayReach(); })()
label: at the door (54 m astern of it), the bay's guidance can take her
and does, without a key
the Wren in the world handed over to the one in the bay's frame
down on the pad, the doors shut, the pad turning her to face the door

eval: JSON.stringify({ s: __game.stats(), turn: __game.parkedWren.rotation.y, fold: __game.parkedWren.userData.folded, use: __game.walker.nearestUse()?.id ?? null })
label: on the deck beside her, facing into the bay, E offering her again; she is nose to the door, wings out, the bay's call over
expect: r => r.use === 'fighter' && r.s.phase === 'walk' && !r.s.fighterOut && r.s.walker[0] < -2 && r.s.walker[2] > 28 && Math.abs(r.turn - Math.PI) < 0.01 && r.fold === 0 && r.s.bay.requested === false

eval: __game.action('KeyE'); JSON.stringify({ s: __game.stats(), blast: __game.interior.doors.bayUpper.k, ladder: __game.interior.bayLadder.visible, canopy: __game.parkedWren.userData.canopyHinge.rotation.x, alarm: __game.interior.alarms.bay ?? null })
label: E skips the launch: flying at once, and the bay left as the full run leaves it
expect: r => r.s.phase === 'fighter' && r.s.fighterOut && r.blast === 0 && !r.ladder && r.canopy === 0 && r.alarm === null

too far: the bay closes and the call is over
